notes_for_editor: Matched by position: the 1925 Bulletin efficiency-flag table is OCR'd in interleaved columns (Chicago Harbor / T. Armstrong, 12th district); the 1924-29 index entry names Armstrong and Chicago Harbor directly. Bulletin 1917 launch names are OCR-garbled. Fiscal-year note: the Oct 7-8 gale is in the fiscal 1899 report, taken as October 1898 because the same entry block dates items to Aug and Dec 1898. The Bulletin 1915 rescue year is inferred from the volume (it also reports the 28-29 September hurricane). Dimensions disagree: record has tower 20 m and focal height 25 m; USLHS gives focal height 67.33 ft and tower 59.33 ft; the landmark report and the Tribune give 82 ft; record range 13 nm vs 'visible 24 miles' in the landmark report and Tribune (units unstated). The current-owner claim rests on LighthouseFriends (2009 transfer) and the Friends' April 2025 newsletter; no NPS record read. Pre-1893 keepers (Lasby etc.) belong to earlier structures and were left off the roster; the existing 'preceded_by us-il-chicago-harbor-2' record presumably covers the 1859 tower. LighthouseFriends is copyrighted and paraphrased only. A 1979 lease of the lighthouse to a private individual is reported by LighthouseFriends and UPI and is omitted as private-resident detail. Landmark report is a preliminary designation report; some of its statements (e.g. collapse 'on the day of its opening', diaphone speed) conflict with Andreas as quoted by LighthouseFriends and were not repeated.
